item.title: v0.5.0
item.description:
What's new

  • A new bee in the menu bar / tray. It flaps its wings while a bot is using this computer, and shows waiting, paused and offline each its own way.
  • Usage, one click on the bee. The usage of every credential you can see: 5-hour and weekly bars with their reset times, in one flat list.
  • Close the window, keep Tiny Hive. Closing the window leaves Tiny Hive in the menu bar only, with no Dock or taskbar icon.
  • Check for Updates. On This Machine and in the tray; the app also looks by itself every hour.

Fixed

  • A slow start no longer drops the app into an empty screen: it waits, says "Starting…", and offers Try Again.
